issues.legal_issue: An application to set aside an execution sale and the required deposit made within the extended limitation period are sufficient despite the shorter period stated for the deposit in the execution procedure rule.
material_facts: A property was sold in execution of a money decree.

The judgment-debtor made an initial deposit and an application to set aside the sale, then made a further application and deposited the balance; the full decretal amount and 5% of the purchase price were deposited within sixty days of the sale.
The auction-purchaser objected that the deposit had not been completed within thirty days.
The lower courts held the sale liable to be set aside, and the Supreme Court dismissed the challenge to that decision.
issues.conclusion: The application and required deposit made within sixty days of the sale were within the limitation period under Article 127, so the sale was liable to be set aside; the special leave petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Order XXI Rules 89 and 92(2) of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, read literally, required both the application and deposit within thirty days. Article 127 of the Limitation Act, 1963, as amended by Act 104 of 1976, provides sixty days for an application to set aside an execution sale, including an application under Rule 89 or Rule 90. The provisions should receive a harmonious construction; Rule 92(2) is inconsistent with Article 127 and requires legislative amendment. The Court approved the approach in Thangammal & Ors. v. K. Dhanalakshmi & Anr., AIR 1981 Mad. 254.

predicates.execution_sale_set_aside_proceeding: A party sought to set aside a sale conducted in execution of a decree.
predicates.application_within_applicable_limitation: The application to set aside the execution sale was made within the applicable limitation period.
predicates.full_required_deposit_within_applicable_: The party completed the deposit required to seek setting aside of the sale within the applicable limitation period.

issues.definition: When a party seeks to set aside an execution sale and makes the application and completes the required deposit within the applicable limitation period, the sale is set aside.
